title: Refactor: route C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt through wp11_backend_ops_t instead of if/else chains
description: wp11_backend_ops_t exists to abstract per-backend dispatch so C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt do not need to know which backend a key uses. The flash backend bypasses this with is_flash_key if/else blocks in all three functions. Every new backend will add another ifdef/if-else block in three places. The ops table was designed for this dispatch and is not being used for it. Fix: add const wp11_backend_ops_t *backend_ops to wp11_key_obj_t, set it when a key object is created (soft backend sets &wp11_backend_soft_ops, flash backend sets &wp11_backend_flash_ops), then C_Sign/C_Verify/C_Decrypt call obj->backend_ops->sign(...) unconditionally. This also eliminates the is_flash_key field and the manual call-sites list comment.
